died.name: Cotton Mather
died.desc: New England Puritan minister and author
died.cause: His wife wiped his eyes with her handkerchief as he said the last words, alluding to Revelation 21:4
died.last_words: Is this dying? Is this all? Is this all that I feared when I prayed against a hard death? Oh! I can bear this! I can bear it! I can bear it! I am going where all tears will be wiped from my eyes.

died.name: Christian Friedrich Schwarz
died.last_words: Had it pleased my Lord to spare me longer I should have been glad. I should then have been able to speak yet a word to the sick and poor; but His will be done! May He, in mercy, but receive me! Into Thy hands I commend my spirit; Thou has redeemed me, O Thou faithful God.

died.name: George Rogers Clark
died.desc: American surveyor, soldier and militia officer
died.last_words: Come on my brave boys! St. Vin.

died.name: Floyd Collins
died.cause: to rescue workers trying to free him from his entrapment in Sand Cave, Kentucky

died.name: Nathanael Edgar
died.cause: describing the circumstances of his being mortally wounded in the line of duty
died.last_words: The man was by the door. I got his identity card and name. I do not know if it is right. He shot me in the legs with three shots. The pocket book is in my inside pocket.

died.name: Murray Hudson
died.cause: to a soldier who froze with an armed grenade; the grenade exploded as Hudson tried to release it, killing both men

born.name: Sophie Arnould
born.cause: when a priest asked how much she had suffered
born.last_words: Ah! The times were good! It was I who was so unhappy.

born.name: Dietrich von Hülsen-Haeseler
born.cause: The Chief of the German Imperial Military Cabinet suffered a heart attack and died aged 56 after giving a ballet performance, crossdressing in a tutu, to Kaiser Wilhelm II and other members of a hunting party staying at Donaueschingen Palace. Shortly after ending his recital with a bow, he collapsed and was pronounced dead at the scene. The circumstances of his death were covered up by military officials so as not to further inflame public outrage over the Eulenburg affair, a government scandal dealing with accusations of homosexual behavior against members of the Kaiser's cabinet and entourage.

born.name: Zhang Zongchang
born.cause: Chinese warlord, after being shot by an assassin

born.name: Vincent R. Capodanno
born.desc: United States Navy Roman Catholic chaplain and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: to a wounded Marine before being killed during Operation Swift in the Vietnam War
born.last_words: Stay quiet, Marine. You will be okay. Someone will be here to help you soon. God is with us all this day.
